# ============================================================================
# SUPPLY-CHAIN HARDENING (applied)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These ranges remain the human-editable manifest (kept in sync with
# requirements-ci.txt). Installs go through requirements.lock — a fully
# pinned + hashed lockfile generated by pip-compile — so every artifact is
# verified by sha256 (see Dockerfile: `pip install --require-hashes`).
#
# Regenerate the lockfile whenever a range here changes, inside an
# ubuntu:22.04 (python 3.10) container so resolution matches deploys:
#
#   docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v "$PWD":/ws -w /ws \
#     ubuntu:22.04@sha256:0a9887931b0e38af2e3487ed39e29436b0535c4f3f52e57745baaf79d1898956 \
#     bash -c 'apt-get update -qq && \
#       apt-get install -y -qq python3 python3-pip python3-dev build-essential && \
#       python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && \
#       python3 -m pip install -q "Cython<3" pip-tools && \
#       PIP_CONSTRAINT=<(echo "Cython<3") \
#         python3 -m piptools compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe \
#         -c constraints.txt --output-file requirements.lock requirements.txt'
#
# constraints.txt carries resolver-only pins (e.g. aiorpcx<0.23) that are
# narrower than the ranges below to match the deployed band — see that file.
# ============================================================================

aiorpcx[ws]>=0.22,<0.26
attrs
plyvel
pylru
aiohttp>=3.3,<4.0
websockets>=10.0,<14.0
psutil
python-rocksdb<=0.7.0
cbor2>=5.4.0

# REST API dependencies
fastapi>=0.109.0
uvicorn[standard]>=0.27.0
pydantic>=2.5.0
prometheus-client>=0.20.0

# OPTIONAL: RSWP swap-order signature verification (C3-auth, Part B).
# Only needed when SWAP_VERIFY_SIGNATURES is enabled — the indexer runs fine
# without it (verification stays default-off, see electrumx/lib/rswp_verify.py).
# Install explicitly to opt in to ECDSA verification of swap advertisements.
coincurve>=21.0.0,<22
